user_reported_bug: The page navigation feature is not working find and fix the problem blocking this feature. Make the application to fit into a respective device.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused /search UI verification showed pagination navigation is fixed: page 3 stays on ?page=3 with items 49-72, Next/Prev/First/Last work, Go-to page 57 works, and changing sort resets to page 1. The responsive/device-fit part is still not fixed: at 390x844 the page has horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth 596 > clientWidth 390).

ui_bugs.issue: On 390px mobile viewport the app still overflows horizontally: document scrollWidth=596 while clientWidth=390. Overflow inspection points to header controls/search form extending past the viewport (theme/cart cluster right=596, header-search-form right=504) and category pill links extending inside the rail. Pagination itself wraps, but the user-visible page does not fit the device.

issues: Horizontal page overflow remains (596px scroll width on 390px viewport).
Header search/action controls and the top category pill rail are laid out wider than the viewport instead of being constrained or safely contained.

action_items: Fix the mobile horizontal overflow on /search, especially the global header search/action row and category pill rail, so document scrollWidth <= clientWidth at 390px.
Retest the focused pagination flow plus mobile responsive metrics after the overflow fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Search.jsx pagination reset effect now excludes page/params/setParams, and runtime testing confirms the original page-navigation reset bug no longer reproduces.

The mobile pagination component met touch-target and wrapping checks (min button height 40px, jump form own row), but the page-level responsive requirement still fails because another header/category component causes horizontal overflow.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 focused checks passed; mobile no-overflow check failed)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing preview listings (2,708 items / 113 pages).
context_for_next_testing_agent: No relevant testing skill found. Pagination-specific behavior passed on live /search: page 3, Next/Prev/First/Last, jump to 57, and sort reset. Recheck mobile 390x844 after fixing overflow; current overflow inspection identified header-search-form/header action controls and [data-testid^="cat-pill-"] elements extending beyond viewport while pagination rect was 366px wide inside the viewport.
rca_of_the_issue: Original pagination RCA appears resolved by removing page from the filter-reset effect dependencies. Remaining failure is responsive: mobile header/search/action controls and category rail content participate in page width beyond the viewport, producing horizontal scroll despite the pagination controls themselves wrapping correctly.
